description: AI lead qualification (BANT) — Qualify an inbound sales lead from an email, form fill or call notes using BANT. Returns tier HOT/WARM/COOL/COLD, a 0-100 score (budget, authority, need, timeline at 0-25 each, totalled offline), evidence quotes, company and contact, buying signals, red flags (including personal-only email addresses), missing info to ask, next step and a reply opener. Params: text= (required, up to 8000 chars), optional product= (what you sell) and icp= (ideal customer). Llama 3.3 70B; judges only from the text. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: Hi, I'm Jane Doe, VP Operations at Acme Logistics (400 staff, 120 trucks). Our dispatchers plan routes in spreadsheets and we want route optimization live before Q1. Budget of about $50k is approved. Can we see a demo next week? jane.doe@acmelogistics.com
